messages.相手の脆弱属性で攻撃するときに、破裂を何回にも分けて付与してパッシブの付与値+1: When attacking a weak resistance, apply Rupture in multiple instances so the passive's +1 application bonus applies each time. S2 The Wrap-up sustains Rupture Count, and S3 Forensics triggers the accumulated Rupture through 4 hits.
messages.S1「直感」の分割付与: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインそれぞれに破裂1の付与が2回ずつある。「[: **S1 Intuition's split infliction**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each have two separate 1-Rupture inflictions: "[Heads Hit/On Hit] 1 Rupture" (on Heads Hit at lower Uptie, on hit at higher Uptie) and "[Heads Hit] 1 Rupture" (Uptie Ⅳ). Because the infliction is split into instances, the passive's +1 below applies to each instance.
messages.バトルパッシブ「本能的看破」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 相手の脆弱属性: **Combat passive — Instinctive Read (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When attacking with an affinity the target is Fatal to (resistance above 1.5), +1 to the Rupture inflicted by skills. +1 more if 4 or more Seven Association Fixers, including himself, are alive at Combat Start.
messages.S2「事後収拾」で回数を維持: マッチ勝利時に破裂回数+1、Ⅰコインの的中時に破: **Maintaining Count with S2 The Wrap-up**: +1 Rupture Count on Clash Win and +2 Rupture Count on Coin Ⅰ hit. As a 1-Coin skill, it adds more Count than it consumes. It also inflicts 1/3 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.S3「現場資料分析」: 4コインで対象の破裂を何度も発動させる。Ⅰコインで破裂回: **S3 — Forensics**: 4 Coins that trigger the target's Rupture repeatedly. Coin Ⅰ adds +3 Rupture Count, and Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ each inflict 1 Rupture on Heads Hit. Defeating an enemy with Coin Ⅳ increases the Rupture Count of the enemy with the least Rupture Count by 2.
messages.破裂6以上で強化(同期化Ⅳ): S1・S3は、対象の破裂が6以上ならコイン威力+: **Bonuses at 6+ Rupture (Uptie Ⅳ)**: S1 and S3 gain +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Rupture.
messages.相手の脆弱属性を突けるときにパッシブを発動させ、S1で破裂威力を一気に積む。S2: Trigger the passive when he can hit the target's weak affinity, and stack Rupture Potency quickly with S1. Keep Count from running out with S2, then fire S3 once Rupture has built up to trigger it repeatedly. S3's Clash Power is a low 4–12, so pick its Clash opponents. He suits fights against high-HP Abnormalities where Rupture's fixed damage pays off, and in the Mirror Dungeon he pairs well with E.G.O Gifts that increase Rupture Potency and Count.
